labels.label: Pamplona
labels.reason: Current municipal sources confirm a live public charging network and 2026 Telpark charging activity/discounts, but no single deterministic network-wide numeric charging tariff is published; station/app-level pricing must be mapped later.

labels.label: Parking Pozuelo
labels.reason: The REVE web label is nominative, but first-pass public research did not establish a unique official operator/tariff authority for this exact label. Nearby Pozuelo charging offers belong to other named CPOs and are not substituted.

labels.label: Patrimonio Natural CyL

labels.label: PAVAPARK MOVILIDAD, S.L.
labels.reason: Official Pavapark sources confirm EV charging management through Moviltik and multiple charging-equipped car parks, but no uniform official numeric charging tariff is published; station-level prices must remain unpromoted until deterministically sourced.
